test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct Active Voice form of the given sentence:

The prize will be given by the judge.

options.text: The judge is giving the prize.
The judge will give the prize.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The passive sentence "The prize will be given by the judge" is in the **Future Simple Tense**.
 
• **Passive to Active Conversion:** To convert a Future Simple sentence from passive to active voice, the structure changes from *Object + will + be + $V_3$ + by + Subject* to **Subject + will + $V_1$ + Object**.
 
• **Identify Subject and Object:** In the passive sentence, the agent (subject) is "the judge" and the receiver (object) is "the prize."
 
• **Verb Change:** The passive verb "will be given" changes to the active form **"will give"** ($V_1$).

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The judge will give the prize."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The judge gives the prize." – Incorrect because it is in the **Simple Present Tense**.
 
• **Option 2: **"The judge is giving the prize." – Incorrect because it is in the **Present Continuous Tense**.
 
• **Option 4: **"The prize gives the judge." – Incorrect because it swaps the logical subject and object, making the sentence nonsensical in this context.
